summary: [Sicher] Retrospective for 5–11 October 2026 (trading week: 5–9 October). Three research papers and two institutional analyses cover valuation, systematic selection, portfolio construction and macro regimes. The implications below are review candidates; publication does not change InvestorAce's investment rules.

items.title: A microeconomic perspective on the cash-flow endogeneity in terminal value models
items.authors: Felix Bogateck and Bernhard Schwetzler · Journal of Business Economics
items.what_changed: [Sicher] The new model makes terminal FCF respond to investment choices, project delays and changing growth/rates; conventional sensitivities can overstate growth effects under its assumptions.
items.investorace_implication: [Wahrscheinlich] Inference: reverse-DCF growth should be modeled with reinvestment requirements and a transition path before estimating distributable cash flow.
items.review_question: Do implied growth, ROIC, reinvestment and terminal cash flow reconcile across scenarios? Compare an offline prototype with NGV/EPV.
items.limitations: [Sicher] Theoretical model with numerical examples, not a stock-return test; project parameters need company-specific calibration.

items.title: Residual Learning in Empirical Asset Pricing
items.authors: Dexin Peng and Xiaoyu Wang · arXiv
items.what_changed: [Sicher] Authors report deep ResNet+ long-short Sharpe 2.07 gross versus 1.30 with 50-bp trading costs; residual connections preserve simpler forecasts.
items.investorace_implication: [Wahrscheinlich] Inference: a learned extension should refine a frozen simple baseline and earn its place through independent forward testing.
items.review_question: Does a residual model outperform simple signals on a reserved sample after costs and multiple-testing controls?
items.limitations: [Sicher] Preprint, US long-short evidence through 2023 and heavy turnover; median imputation differs from InvestorAce's missing-data discipline.

items.title: Multi-period Mean-Expectile Portfolio Optimization under Wasserstein Ambiguity: Reformulation, Degeneracy and the Role of the Ground Metric
items.authors: Rupendra Yadav and Aparna Mehra · arXiv
items.what_changed: [Sicher] The new derivation shows the risk component can become inactive beyond a critical ambiguity radius; the distance metric can favor concentration or diversification.
items.investorace_implication: [Wahrscheinlich] Inference: portfolio risk controls need diagnostics proving that they affect allocations, alongside sensitivity to modeling choices.
items.review_question: Across stress radii and distance metrics, do weights, maximum position size and downside losses actually change?
items.limitations: [Sicher] Preprint; end-of-sample FTSE constituents introduce survivorship bias. Main results are gross; supplemental cost checks cannot remove that bias.

items.title: Why equities can still thrive as bond yields rise
items.what_changed: [Sicher] This outlook argues strong earnings can offset higher yields and distinguishes supply-driven inflation from the 2022 demand shock.
items.investorace_implication: [Wahrscheinlich] Inference: rising yields alone cannot establish a macro regime; valuation stress should separate rates from cash-flow growth.
items.review_question: Replay rising-yield episodes using contemporaneous growth/inflation inputs; stress discount rates and cash-flow growth separately while preserving unweighted regime fit.
items.limitations: [Sicher] Institutional scenario analysis, not a validated classifier; broad rate-sensitivity claims need stock-level verification.

items.title: Asia-Pacific: A real diversifier for US equity risk
items.authors: Joshua Crabb and Helen Keung · Robeco
items.what_changed: [Sicher] The analysis compares Asia-Pacific with Asia ex-Japan: reported technology weights are 33.9% versus 46.4%, with lower historical volatility in the broader index.
items.investorace_implication: [Wahrscheinlich] Inference: different country labels can hide common technology exposure; benchmark composition matters to diversification.
items.review_question: Measure region, currency and sector overlap, then compare stressed correlations before expanding the stock universe.
items.limitations: [Sicher] Asset-manager perspective; August 2026 index data and gross USD histories do not prove forward diversification for InvestorAce.

priority_review: [Wahrscheinlich] Start with valuation consistency: reconcile implied growth, reinvestment/ROIC and terminal FCF, then test transition scenarios against NGV/EPV in an offline prototype. Keep regime fit unweighted and separate from scoring.
